title: Northbridge Formulary Benefit: Period of a Tier Exception Approval
content:
**Period.** The period of a tier exception approval under the Formulary Benefit is the formulary's standard approval length in months. It is never shorter than one month, and it is a whole number of months.

*Question and answer.*

- *On which figure does the tier approval period rest?* On the standard approval length in months of the member's Northbridge formulary.
- *Can the period be a fraction of a month?* No. It is a whole number of months, and at least one.

*Worked figure (hypothetical length).* With a standard approval length of 12 months and a decision on 2 February 2026, the approval runs 12 months and expires on 1 February 2027.
